cr_data.provenance: (The Intimate Gallery, New York, NY); Mitchell Kennerley, New York, NY, 1929; (An American Place, New York, NY); The artist, return, 1931; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Private collection, Great Neck, New York, 1968; Descended in family; Donald Morris Gallery, Inc., Birmingham, Michigan, 1974; Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY, 1974; Private foundation, Stowe, Vermont, 1974; (Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); (Joshua Strychalski, New York, NY); (Helene Wasserman Fine Art, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1976; ACA Galleries, New York, NY, 1978; Private collection, New York, NY, 1978; Christie's, New York, NY, sale no. 5212, lot no. 9, 10 November 1992 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, Mar. 1946" [notes verso inscription]. Titled *Red Barn, Wisconsin*, 1927, by Stieglitz on photograph of picture in private collection. Either this or cat. no. 617 mentioned in *New York Times* (January 1932) at Reinhardt Galleries. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A large red barn, seen from the side, rises from brown and green earth. A white fence runs along the left side of the canvas. Above the scene, a cloudy gray sky swirls as though threatening to rain.
